mapper.insert: insert into material(type_id, name, spec, price, warn_threshold, del_flag, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{typeId}, #{name}, #{spec}, #{price}, #{warnThreshold}, 0, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from material where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0
select * from material where type_id = #{typeId} and del_flag = 0

select * from material where del_flag = 0
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
order by create_time desc

select m.*, mt.name as type_name from material m left join material_type mt on m.type_id = mt.id where m.del_flag = 0
and m.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and m.type_id = #{typeId}
order by m.create_time desc
